limits: Reference map positions and guide landmarks were cross-checked in software/source review. Moving, random and match-dependent locations are labelled. No full in-game playthrough was performed.

locations.basis: Search the hill/tower above Nahr Bathhouse around F4. Match the Drum, Mirror, Gloves and Target at the gold-relic pedestals; the guide has the full unlock.
Search Tier 3’s northwest island circle around E3/E4. The Giraffe, Laptop, Drawing and Journal ritual is separate from ordinary triangle rewards. Use the island landmark to resolve the grid boundary.
Search the F5 Opal Palace fountain tornado. Use gold Mr. Peeks and the three gold Echo relics; the Ascension story portal is at the nearby northeast gazebo.
Offer the Mirror at the I3 graveyard pedestal and use the matching elemental mod on its marked zombie.
At the F8 boxing gym, offer the Gloves, melee the bags left to right and finish the marked zombie.
At H8’s firing range, offer the Target, shoot all eight targets and headshot the marked zombie.
Search the four-pillar square east of F7 Shorok Opera House. Use the pillar meteor and match the elemental zombies.
Search the wrecked van in the square east of F4 Nahr Bathhouse. Use its meteor and finish the marked enemy chain.
Search the canal around F4/G4 by Mister Peeks. Follow the actual white arrows on the Blood Burner; this pin does not draw the riding route.
Search the southern opening, field east of centre, and northern announcer booth. The guide photographs describe the individual stones; this is the stadium area.

Elder-only Infinite Cosmos: search under the main Highrise building for the unmarked spore and R4D detector, follow its arrows for the skull, then find the Golden Whale lobby across from the detector building. This broad footprint does not pinpoint the spore, skull or whale head.
Search the C3 Spec Electronics building and its second-floor error-screen computer. Carry the IT Thumb Drive; activate the computer before fighting the marked Keyholder.
Return to the roof/exfil level with the Maintenance Tower Key. Find its locked maintenance door and bring every squad member inside before using the purple boss portal.
